scope: Proposition 8.5 of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, B) be a projective lc fourfold pair over C with rational boundary, with D = KX + B Q-Cartier. Every D-negative extremal ray has a projective contraction with normal projective target, connected fibres, relative Picard number one, and relatively ample −D. If this contraction is birational, it has an output in the precise convention of Definition 1.1: the positive map is small, possibly an isomorphism, and its actual adjoint with the strict boundary is relatively ample and lc. If it is of fibre type, it is a Mori fibre-space endpoint in that convention.
